Īryākulaka
Jain. BP. p. 233b. See Ī. pathikākulaka below.

Īryāpatha
Jain. Arrah I. p. 4 (7 mss.). Malakheda 24. Moodbidri II. 400 (3). 662 (2).

Īryāpathapratikramaṇa
Jain. Arrah I. p. 4 (saM. prA.).

Īryāpatha(thi)sāmāyika
Jain. Arrah I. p. 4 (2 mss.). Moodbidri I. 201 (e).

Īryāpathika(kā)
Jain. Arrah I. p. 4 (2 mss.). BORI. 135 of 1873-74. D. p. 61. Kh. 135. Peters. V. p. 278 (no. 628 (2)).
--C. Cūrṇi. Chani 154.

Īryāpathikā(kī)kulaka
Jain. Chani 3913 (with C.). Jainagranthāvalī p. 196.
--C. Stabaka. Chani 3913.

Īryāpathikāṣaṭtriṃśikā
Jain. by Jayasoma. Jainagranthāvalī p. 139.
--C. by a. Ibid. p. 139. [Page263-b]

Īryāpathikā(vicāra)ṣaṭtriṃśikā
(Iriyāvahiyaviyārachattisiyā) Jain. Pkt.
by Dharmasāgara Gaṇi, pupil of Ānandavimala Sūri. BORI. 368 of 1880-81. BORI. D. XVIII. i. 183. 184. 185. D. p. 191. Jainagranthāvalī p. 139. Kh. 76.
Pt.. Āgamodaya Samiti Series 49.
--C. Vivaraṇa by the a. himself. BORI. 368 of 1880-81. BORI. D. XVIII. i. 183. 184. 185. D. p. 191. Jainagranthāvalī p. 139. JBhP. I. 266. Kh. 76.

Īryāpathikāsambandhimithyāduṣkṛta
with C. Jain. One verse in Pkt. an. its explanation in Skt. Enumeration of 5630 mithyāduṣkṛṭas. BORI. D. XVII. iv. a. 1198.

Īryāpathikīprakaraṇa
Jain. Jainagranthāvalī p. 149.
--C. Avacūrṇi by Yaśodeva. Jainagranthāvalī p. 28.

Īryāpathikīsūtra
Jain. Pkt. BORI. D. XVII. iii. a. 790 (with C.). 791-4. For Extr.. see BBRAS. iii-iv. p. 398.
Pt.. with Pratikramaṇa Sūtras. Ed. also by H. R. Kapadia. 4th Kiraṇāvalī, Ārhatajīvanajjyoti, p.. 71-2.
See also Haribhadrasūri's C. on Āvaśyakasūtra, Yogaśāstra (iii) with C. by Hemacandra, Ācāradinakara, Vandāruvṛtti, Dharmasaṅgrahavṛtti, an. Ubersicht über die Āvaśyaka-liter atür (p. 2).
